science.qualification: Color of a black body at the dayside brightness temperature 2,048 K measured in secondary eclipse at 4 µm (Boucher et al. 2026, dayside temperature of the combined NIRSpec G395H phase-curve fit, 2048 +193 -206 K), uniform over the disc and lit by its star so the day side faces it. The planet is unresolved: no map is implied, and reflected starlight is not included.

metadata.limbMeaning: The adopted source-radius opaque-sphere silhouette and prepared phase lighting define the limb; no atmospheric rim is inferred.
